user.title: Find your Govee H1167
user.description: Home Assistant currently sees {count} BLE devices: {connectable_count} connectable and {scan_only_count} scan-only. This list includes all BLE advertisements, not just names containing H1167. Select only your H1167, scan again, or enter its MAC manually.

manual.title: Enter H1167 Bluetooth address
manual.description: If your H1167 is not listed, enter its address. A connectable Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter or proxy is still needed for commands.

confirm_device.title: Confirm this is your H1167
confirm_device.description: The selected Bluetooth device advertises as {name} ({address}) but does not identify itself as H1167. Only continue if you KNOW this is your Govee H1167 Light Show Box. Other devices are not supported.

data.confirm_h1167: I confirm that this is my Govee H1167

error.invalid_address: Use a valid Bluetooth MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.device_not_found: The device is no longer visible. Refresh or try manual setup.
error.not_connectable: This device was seen by a scan-only receiver. Bring it into range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter/proxy and scan again.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm that this is your actual H1167 before proceeding.

abort.not_h1167: This Bluetooth device is not identified as an H1167.
